source: NOID_Mexico_1988_500Pesos_obv.jpg (owner chat 2026-10-13); owner corrected date to 1988. Numista N#819 (https://en.numista.com/819): 500 Pesos, KM#529, 1986-1992, Madero

new.story: A 1988 Mexican 500 peso coin with Francisco Madero — the leader who started the Mexican Revolution in 1910. These big old pesos were used before Mexico dropped three zeros from its money in 1993.
new.notes: Blind double-read. 1988 / Madero / $500 / M° per owner correction (photo date worn). SUPERSEDES changes_muse_20261013-0852.jsonl which misread the date as 1989.
